failure.message: The installed PyTorch wheel supported sm_70 and newer, but the controlled Kaggle P100 protocol requires sm_60. Model initialization failed with cudaErrorNoKernelImageForDevice.

disposition: Negative evidence retained. No comparative result is valid because all three records did not complete in the same bundled run. The corrective bundle pins an sm_60-compatible PyTorch runtime and asserts architecture support before measurement.
